commands.required_marker: OBS exact checked lower-bound C providers

limits: Exact three PR-T37-08 ordinary/changed mechanisms with native host observations; no independently assessed learner or elapsed delay.
All31 samples/condition retained; no required speedup threshold, outlier filtering or overhead subtraction.
Same sortedness admission on actual reused C and assembly providers; measured checked API includes validation/calls, not isolated raw loop.
Size and cache-preparation interventions are separate;8MiB displacement before a batch is not proof of a cold cache for every query.
Frequency, interrupts, virtualization and intervening CPU migration remain uncontrolled; endpoint CPU equality is not a no-migration proof.
Instrumented and uninstrumented profiles are distinguished; no physical Cortex-M cycles, WCET, energy or universal ranking.
Exact rational/drift models remain synthetic, separately labeled; final ISO and independent review gaps unchanged.
